bends.reason: In the section across B1 (bend_01.png), the registered scan densely covers both sides of the line and follows the blue FORMED profile, not the orange NOT_FORMED one. I measured the plot pixels at 10 px/mm. On the child side the scan's top surface is within about 0.1-0.5 mm of the FORMED profile from -35 to -2 mm. At the same points the NOT_FORMED profile is 2.0 mm away at -4.5 mm, 4.4 mm at -9.5 mm, 9.1 mm at -19.5 mm and 13 mm at -29.5 mm. The scan's surface slope changes by about 26 deg at the line (+12.4 deg on the child side, -13.3 deg on the flange side). The CAD's formed profile changes by about 24 deg, and an unformed bend would show about 0 deg. The scan also matches the CAD's shallow reverse kink about 10 mm inboard of the line. In the overlay ISO, TOP and FRONT views, the scan covers the whole flange strip with holes along the full length of the line, and its holes and free edge sit at the CAD positions. The only gap is an edge offset of about 1 mm, which fits normal scanner loss at sheet edges. So the bend is formed along its whole length. It is a shallow bend of about 24 deg, above the 15 deg convention for counting a bend as formed.
